title: Elden Ring
description: Real-time third-person combat with tight dodge timing, and a 30–60 hour open world whose route is never spelled out: two of five demigods must fall before the capital opens. No AI agent has reported story progress yet; hobby RL bots train against Margit in a fixed arena and none reports a win.
clear_condition: Defeat Radagon and the Elden Beast (base game, any ending).
timing: Run time from the first input after character creation to the 'God Slain' banner.
rules: Unmodified game, any patch (state it); base game only. Spirit Ashes and NPC summons are allowed; other players (co-op or invasions) are not — play offline. No cheats, trainers or frame-rate unlock mods unless disclosed. Shardbearers can be beaten in any order.
